happening.subject: actor/rafter-spider
happening.text: Something comes down out of the rafters.

telegraph.text: Something shifts up in the rafters.

lethal_volumes.message: The floor in the west corner is not a floor.
The air along the north wall does not agree with you.

on_death.text: The hall puts you back at the hearth.

npc/curator.doing: standing at the lectern with the catalogue open

barks: Everything on the counter is priced.
The emeralds are the hall's, not mine.

npc/marshal.doing: calling the muster, once the party has passed the lectern

happening.subject: npc/curator
happening.text: The party arrives in the near hall and the Curator looks up.

happening.subject: npc/curator
happening.text: The Curator tells them what the hall is for.

objectives.hint: The Curator stands at the lectern.
objectives.title: Hear the Curator

happening.subject: anchor/pedestal
happening.text: The case opens under their hand.

objectives.hint: The case stands in the middle of the near hall.
objectives.missing_item_hint: The Curator gave you the case key. It only opens the case from your hand.
objectives.title: Open the case

happening.subject: anchor/pedestal
happening.text: They take the emeralds out of the case.

objectives.hint: Four of them, in the case.
objectives.title: Take the emeralds

happening.subject: npc/factor
happening.text: They reach the counter.

objectives.hint: The Factor keeps the counter on the east side of the near hall.
objectives.title: Reach the counter

happening.subject: anchor/gate-main
happening.text: The main gate goes up.

on_rest.text: The hearth takes the chill off.

happening.subject: npc/marshal
happening.text: The Marshal takes the far hall.

happening.subject: anchor/muster
happening.text: The muster forms up beyond the wall.

happening.subject: npc/warden
happening.text: The Warden steps behind the wall and does not come back.

happening.subject: npc/curator
happening.text: The Curator walks to the case.

on_arrive.text: "Read the far side too," she says.

happening.subject: npc/warden
happening.text: The Warden goes over the wall line rather than round it.

npc/factor.doing: shutting the counter for the day

npc/marshal.doing: calling the muster to a party that read the label
calling the muster to a party that walked straight past

happening.subject: anchor/muster
happening.text: Past the wall the far hall is already mustering.

happening.subject: npc/marshal
happening.text: The Marshal stops the party at the muster line and asks after the lectern.

objectives.hint: She is at the muster line, and she wants the lectern accounted for.
objectives.title: Answer the Marshal

happening.subject: actor/sergeant
happening.text: The muster is put down.

objectives.hint: They are at the muster line.
objectives.title: Clear the muster

happening.subject: anchor/muster
happening.text: They pick the muster's bone up off the flagstones.

objectives.hint: It is where the muster fell.
objectives.title: Take the muster's bone

happening.subject: anchor/loft
happening.text: They climb the flight they put back and come out over the hall.

objectives.hint: Up the flight, once its treads are back.
objectives.title: Climb to the mezzanine

happening.subject: anchor/exit
happening.text: They come to the end of the hall.

objectives.title: Reach the end of the hall

on_respawn.text: You come back at the lectern, where the reading started.

on_complete.ending: The hall is read end to end.

happening.subject: anchor/exit
happening.text: The hall goes quiet behind them.

happening.subject: anchor/march
happening.text: A lane opens down the far hall behind them.

happening.subject: actor/hall-moth
happening.text: Something large comes off the rafters.

happening.subject: actor/hall-moth
happening.text: It stops circling and comes down.

happening.subject: actor/standard-bearer
happening.text: The bearer carries the colours up to the vantage.

happening.subject: actor/standard-bearer
happening.text: The colours are struck.

happening.subject: npc/factor
happening.text: The Factor gives up the counter and the hall loses its trade.

happening.subject: anchor/gate-main
happening.text: The main gate comes down again.

obj/clear-the-muster.sealed_hint: The main gate has come back down and will not lift from this side.

obj/clear-the-muster.text: Keep out of the light until the march has passed.

happening.subject: actor/rafter-spider
happening.text: The spider takes the yard the long way, on its feet.

happening.subject: actor/rafter-spider
happening.text: The spider is put down where it landed.

happening.subject: npc/marshal
happening.text: The Marshal climbs the course and drops into the yard.

happening.subject: npc/marshal
happening.text: The Marshal leaves the yard once the muster is answered for.

npc/curator.doing: still at the case, not watching the shaft

npc/marshal.doing: forming up beyond the wall, indifferent to the cellar
forming up beyond the wall, having walked straight past the label

happening.subject: anchor/east-bay
happening.text: Some of them stop at the side bays to look at what is not on the way out.

happening.subject: anchor/east-bay
happening.text: The east bay keeps what the hall has stopped showing.

happening.subject: anchor/west-bay
happening.text: The west bay keeps the rest of it, and nothing on the way out needs any of it.

happening.subject: anchor/east-bay
happening.text: Something that was watching the east bay closes on it.

on_unlock.text: The side door is barred no longer.

stakes.collected_message: You take back the tokens the hall took.
Only you can lift your own relics.

state.name: Labels read
state.note: How many of the hall's labels the party has read. Party-scoped: the hall is read once, by whoever reads it.

state.name: Tokens
state.note: The wager a stake carries. Player-scoped, because a stake is dropped by the body that died.

state.name: Relics
state.note: The second wager, so the gallery can show a forfeit that takes everything beside one that takes a share.

state.name: Toll
state.note: A flat toll: the same two whatever you were carrying.

state.name: Keepsake
state.note: A wager a death does not touch, which is what makes the other three legible.

payload.text: A plate clicks under the flagstone.
The chest was not the exhibit.

effects.text: The label under the case reads: every surface, written once.
The Warden does not answer a blow.
From here the whole hall is one picture.
The side door is barred from the other side.
